name: Mexican Enchilada Bake
description: A hearty, layered enchilada casserole with chicken, beans, rice, and cheese, topped with a tangy tomato-salsa sauce.
recipeIngredient: 2½ cups tomato sauce or ¾ cup each diced carrots and diced canned tomatoes
1 can (19 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Combine tomato sauce, salsa, 2 teaspoons chili powder, and 2 teaspoons cumin in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together chicken, rice, beans, carrots, red pepper, onion, lime juice, cilantro, remaining 2 teaspoons chili powder, and remaining 1 teaspoon cumin.
Spray a 9x13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
Spread 1 cup of the sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange 6 tortillas over the sauce, overlapping as necessary.
Spoon another 1 cup of sauce over the tortillas and spread evenly. Top with half of the bean mixture and half of the cheese.
Arrange the remaining tortillas on top. Cover with another 1 cup of sauce, followed by the remaining bean mixture and remaining cheese.
Spoon any remaining sauce over the top. Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and heated through.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Top individual servings with a dollop of sour cream.

keywords: enchilada casserole, Mexican bake, chicken and cheese

_similar.name: Spaghetti Sauce
_similar.description: A rich and flavorful homemade spaghetti sauce made with tomato paste, tomato sauce, and ground beef, simmered for several hours.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine all ingredients except ground beef in a large pot. Cook gently for at least 2 hours.
Sauté the ground beef until browned, drain off fat, and add to the sauce.
Continue cooking gently for another 2 hours.

_similar.name: Tortilla Soup
_similar.description: A flavorful Mexican-inspired soup with chicken, vegetables, and crispy tortilla chips.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute chicken pieces with onion, garlic, and spices until chicken is cooked through.
Add 4 cups water and boil to make stock.
Remove chicken and chop, discarding any bones and skin.
Combine remaining ingredients (except tortilla chips, sour cream, and cheese) and heat through.
To serve, place tortilla chips in soup bowls.
Pour soup over chips and top with sour cream, jalapenos (optional), and shredded cheddar cheese.

_similar.keywords: tortilla soup, Mexican soup, chicken soup, spicy soup

_similar.name: Nacho Fiesta Dip
_similar.description: A layered dip featuring cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning, topped with lettuce, tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: Large bag tortilla chips for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix cottage cheese, cream cheese, and taco seasoning together in a blender until well combined.
Place the mixture in a large bowl lined with Saran Wrap and refrigerate covered for 1 hour.
Remove the dip from the bowl by tipping it onto a platter or large plate and peeling off the Saran Wrap.
Cover the dip with shredded lettuce, then diced tomatoes, and finally grated cheddar cheese.
Surround with tortilla chips and serve.

_similar.keywords: layered dip, nacho fiesta, taco seasoning, cheesy dip

_similar.name: Chinese Hamburger Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty, savory casserole featuring ground hamburger, rice, and vegetables, with an optional addition of bean sprouts for an authentic touch.

recipeInstructions.text: Thoroughly brown hamburger in a skillet; add the onions, celery, cream of mushroom and cream of chicken soups.
Stir in the mushrooms, warm water, uncooked rice, soya sauce, pepper and salt.
Add bean sprouts if using for a more authentic taste.
Turn the ingredients into a casserole dish and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Remove cover, stir the casserole and continue baking for about 15 minutes longer.
Sprinkle chow mein noodles over casserole and bake for 15 minutes more (total baking time is 1 hour).

_similar.keywords: Chinese casserole, hamburger casserole, rice casserole
